code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The palette is a row repeated three times; remove that key from the canvas.
    key_rows = None
    for r in range(h - 2):
        row = grid[r]
        if sum(v != 0 for v in row) >= 2 and row == grid[r + 1] == grid[r + 2]:
            key_rows = r
            break
    if key_rows is None:
        raise ValueError("three-row repeated palette not found")
    palette = [v for v in grid[key_rows] if v != 0]
    key_cells = {(rr, c) for rr in range(key_rows, key_rows + 3)
                 for c, v in enumerate(grid[rr]) if v != 0}
    cells = [(r, c, v) for r in range(h) for c, v in enumerate(grid[r])
             if v != 0 and (r, c) not in key_cells]
    if not cells:
        raise ValueError("shape not found")
    shape_color = cells[0][2]
    if any(v != shape_color for _, _, v in cells):
        raise ValueError("expected one-color shape")
    top = min(r for r, _, _ in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, _, _ in cells)
    left = min(c for _, c, _ in cells)
    right = max(c for _, c, _ in cells)
    motif = [(r-top, c-left) for r, c, _ in cells]
    mh = bottom - top + 1
    if shape_color not in palette:
        raise ValueError("shape color absent from palette")
    anchor = palette.index(shape_color)
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for i, color in enumerate(palette):
        y = top + (i-anchor)*mh
        for dr, dc in motif:
            rr, cc = y+dr, left+dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
for name, inp, expected in [('demo1',d1,o1),('demo2',d2,o2)]:
    got=mod.transform(inp)
    print(name,got==expected)

ans=mod.transform(test)
